title.narrative: This activity will contribute to achieving results for the BARMM: Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) AND CLIMATE ACTION/DRR output

description.narrative: By 2028, children, households and communities in BARMM have increased access to resilient and at least basic water and sanitation services, and government authorities have improved capacities to deliver Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) services to the communities and institutions and in disaster risk reduction. This work breakdown structure activity contributed to sublevel results - Climate change, disaster risks and envionmental degradation,Safely managed drinking water, sanitation and hygiene,Children reached by solutions that reduce the risks of climate disasters and environmental hazards,Cross sectoral - Social and behaviour change

title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened climate-resilient, child-centered systems in BARMM by supporting the Bangsamoro Disaster Response Plan and enhancing DRRM plans in 46 LGUs,upgrading WASH facilities in schools, early childhood centers, and health facilites, and enabling 40 LGUs to achieve open-defecation-free status improving children's access to safe water, sanitation, and healthier learning environments.
